title: The decoy hashes every body while the GitHub verifier skips the HMAC for a missing or malformed signature, so timing tells known integrations apart
resolution: The composition's GithubWebhookDecoy repeats the plugin's work per signature form: no HMAC for a missing or malformed signature, HMAC and constant-time comparison for a well-formed one; a test counts the crypto calls of known and unknown integrations.

title: PostgreSQL text columns reject a NUL and cannot keep an unpaired surrogate of an identifier that the port accepts
resolution: The identifiers are stored as bytea of their UTF-16LE code units with length and parity checks; an integration test records and decodes a NUL and unpaired surrogates exactly.

title: The plugin receipt test of a ping depends on the record of the preceding test
resolution: Each test builds its own plugin, receiver, and record, and the ping test asserts its own record stays empty.

title: The migration, plugin receipt, and access requirement tests have no recorded fail-before run
resolution: The record names negative-control runs for each migration constraint, the down migration, installation_repositories handling, and the operation's security, each failing and passing once restored.
